about.title: About the NGO Paws for Adoption
about.subtitle: The NGO Paws for Adoption was born to transform abandonment into hope. Our work is to welcome animals in vulnerable situations, promote essential care, and find families prepared to offer love, security, and commitment.

rescue.title: Rescue
rescue.text: We welcome dogs and cats in situations of abandonment, risk, or vulnerability.

care.title: Care
care.text: We aim to offer food, protection, affection, and essential care until adoption.

adoption.title: Responsible Adoption
adoption.text: We connect each animal with conscious, prepared, and committed families.

adoption.title: Animals waiting for a home
adoption.subtitle: Meet some paws that are ready for a new story.

process.title: How adoption works
process.subtitle: Adoption is a gesture of love, but also responsibility. Therefore, we follow some steps to ensure the best for each animal.

steps.title: You meet the available animals
steps.text: See the pets waiting for a family and choose the one you connect with.

steps.title: We talk about your routine
steps.text: We understand your space, routine, experience, and expectations.

steps.title: We evaluate the match
steps.text: We seek to ensure the chosen pet matches your family and lifestyle.

steps.title: We follow the adaptation
steps.text: We stay close in the first moments to support this new beginning.

stories.title: Happy stories
stories.subtitle: Every adoption is a new beginning. Here we celebrate matches that became family.

items.quote: I was afraid to adopt because I had never had a dog. The Paws NGO team helped me understand what to expect and Bolinho arrived home as if he had always been ours. Today he is the joy of the family.
items.name: Mariana S.

items.quote: Mel arrived scared, hiding under the bed. Three months later she is already purring in my lap. Seeing this transformation was a gift I didn't expect.
items.name: Carlos R.

items.quote: I adopted Pipoca for my mother, who lived alone. He arrived and filled the house with life. She calls me every day to tell me what he's been up to. It was the best decision I've made.
items.name: Fernanda L.

items.q: How does the adoption process work?
items.a: The process starts with a conversation to understand your routine, your space, and the animal profile best suited for your family. From there, we present the available animals and evaluate the best match together.

items.q: Is there a cost for adoption?
items.a: Adoption itself is not a sale. In some cases, a solidarity contribution may be requested to help with care costs, neutering, vaccination, or treatment. This is discussed transparently during the process.

items.q: Can I adopt if I live in an apartment?
items.a: Yes, as long as the environment is safe, screened when necessary, and suitable for the size and behavior of the animal. We talk about this during the adoption process.

items.q: Are the animals neutered and vaccinated?
items.a: Whenever possible, animals are sent with veterinary follow-up. Information about each pet — health, history, and needs — is shared transparently during the process.

items.q: How can I help without adopting?
items.a: You can donate food or care items, sponsor an animal, contribute to veterinary costs, be a volunteer, offer a temporary home, or simply spread the word about the animals on your social networks.

items.q: How do I become a temporary home?
items.a: Get in touch via WhatsApp to talk about your availability, space, and experience with animals. Temporary housing is a huge help for pets waiting for adoption.
